title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): code blocks preview code, charts and diagrams inline in Chat
summary: The roadmap facts, licensing background and code-preview policy are supported. Two minor corrections remain: include policy scope selection in the navigation path, and classify this layout change as preparation rather than an optional capability review. The earlier fetch warnings did not recur.

claims.where: front matter: action; Why it matters
claims.claim: Review is the appropriate action classification for this change in an existing preview layout.
claims.quote: action: "review"; "The roadmap describes a change in preview placement"; "Users on desktop and mobile may see previews inline where the roadmap says they previously used a side-by-side code canvas."
claims.fix: Set action to 'prepare'. Replace 'this is a feature to review and plan communications for, not one with a deadline' with 'this is a layout change to prepare communications for, with no administrator deadline stated.' The assessment scale assigns prepare to redesigns of existing experiences even when the arrival default is unknown.
